flows:
Navigate to https://velu2k03.github.io/readme-lie-detector/ then Open https://velu2k03.github.io/readme-lie-detector/ in the browser.
Wait for the report page to finish loading.
Scroll through the whole page and count the individual claim cards.
Count the claim cards on the report page.
Assert The page shows one card per claim.
Assert The number of claim cards is 8.
Store The number of claim cards shown on the report page, as a digit as 'claim_card_count'.

one_card_per_claim_check.query: whether one card per claim is present (in the Claims section)
one_card_per_claim_check.condition: The page shows one card per claim.
one_card_per_claim_check.human_description: Checking the claim-card mapping in the Claims section
one_card_per_claim_check.subject: one card per claim
one_card_per_claim_check.code_js: (() => { const articles = [...el(1).querySelectorAll('article.card[id]')]; const ids = articles.map(a => a.id); const report = [...el(1).querySelectorAll('h1')].some(h => /All 8 claims are true/.test(h.textContent || '')); return report && ids.length === 8 && ids.every((id, i) => id === `c${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`); })()
